# S109 — Run pane follows the newest running run, with a 1 s ledger refresh while a run is visible

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Owner 2026-10-25, from a screenshot of the Overview with a run pane open (S28's relay): when the opened run finishes the pane does not update; the owner has to esc and select the next running item to see the status of its steps. The pane is pinned to the run id it was opened on (internal/tui/pane.go:15-29, paneRow) and only changes with a snapshot (every 5 s for the visible project). Owner decisions: (1) when the run in the pane finishes the pane automatically switches to the newest running run (no toggle); (2) a 1 s ledger refresh while a pane or Running row is visible. Not addressed by the run-card, fold or S99 slices.

## Files

- `internal/tui/pane.go:16-52` (runPane, openPane, paneRow) and `internal/tui/model.go:650-700` (apply): on each snapshot, when the pane's run has ended and a newer running run exists in the same project, re-point the pane to it; keep the offset reset and the answer-input state sane; when no running run exists, stay on the ended run with its final state.
- `internal/cache/cache.go:34-36` and `internal/cache/cache.go:160-167` (intervalLocked): a 1 s interval for the Runs part (`internal/source/source.go:108`, :141, relay-run list --active) while the project is visible and has a live run; pushed through the existing notice feed (`internal/daemon/subscribe.go`, `internal/daemon/feed.go`; the TUI refetches at `internal/tui/model.go:374-377`).
- `internal/poll/poll.go:12-19` (DefaultSchedule) only if the TUI poller needs it.
- `internal/tui/view.go` and `internal/tui/relayboard.go`: a one-line notice in the pane header when it switched ("switched to S28; S27 ended pass") that fades after the next refresh.
- Tests beside each; goldens `testdata/golden/board-pane-*.txt` and `testdata/golden/pane-*.txt`; `docs/dashboard.md` (pane section), `docs/design.md` (refresh policy).

## Failing tests

- TestPaneSwitchesToTheNewestRunningRunWhenItsRunEnds: the pane was opened on run A; A ends and run B (same project) is running; the next snapshot re-points the pane to B and shows the switch notice.
- TestPaneStaysOnTheEndedRunWhenNothingElseRuns: shows the final state, frozen bar, no switch.
- TestPaneDoesNotSwitchWhileTheOwnerIsTypingAnAnswer: a paused question pane with text in the input does not re-point (the answer is for that run).
- TestPaneSwitchResetsScrollOffset.
- TestLedgerRefreshIsOneSecondForTheVisibleProjectWhileARunIsLive and returns to 5 s and 30 s otherwise (injected clock).
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

## Implement

1. Tests first (injected clock). 2. The re-point rule in the snapshot handler. 3. The faster refresh in the daemon/poll loop, only for the visible project with a live run. 4. The switch notice. 5. Docs and goldens. UI slice: UI pass (r14). Decided 2026-10-25 (owner): always auto-switch to the newest running run; 1 s refresh while visible.
Open for the preflight to settle with the owner: whether the switch may cross projects (recommend same project only), and what happens to an open answer input (recommend: never switch a pane whose answer input has text).

Owner decisions (2026-10-25 batch spec check, all recommended): (1) follow engine runs in SectionRunning plus active ledger runs not linked to an engine run (relays started elsewhere; the ps.running logic, model.go ~678-690). (2) switch only when the pane's run is terminal (stopped, committed, ended, superseded); paused and awaiting-approval runs stay in the pane. (3) the 1 s refresh is the cache's Runs interval for a visible project with a live run, not a faster whole-snapshot poller. Same project only. No switch while an answer field has text. The two former open points are settled.
